original_messages.speaker: David
original_messages.message: No one else was in Admin besides Eve and Charlie. Eve must have killed him.

original_messages.speaker: Eve
original_messages.message: David was in Storage which connects to Admin. You could've returned to kill Charlie!

original_messages.speaker: Alice
original_messages.message:
"Eve, since you reported Charlie's body in Admin, you were there with him. Did you see anyone else enter or leave before finding the body?"
"Eve, if you were in Admin when Charlie died, why didn't you see the killer?"

original_messages.speaker: Eve
original_messages.message: I arrived after the kill - Charlie was already dead when I entered Admin.

original_messages.speaker: Alice
original_messages.message:
"Eve, if you arrived after the kill, who left Admin before you entered? The killer must have been there."
Eve, who left Admin before you arrived? The killer must have escaped.

original_messages.speaker: David
original_messages.message: "Eve, if you entered Admin after Charlie's death, who left just before you? The killer had to escape!"

benchmark_dataset.reason_summary: Eve was voted out because she failed to provide a convincing explanation for her presence in Admin after Charlie's death, leading others to suspect her involvement in the murder.
